title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 29
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 29: the word against Pharaoh king of Egypt, the forty years of desolation, and the land of Egypt given as wages to Babylon's king.

questions.text: What had Pharaoh king of Egypt said about his river?
questions.explanation: He is called the great monster that lies in the middle of his rivers, who said: My river is my own, and I have made it for myself.

answers.text: That his river is his own and he made it
That his river comes down from heaven
That his river waters all the nations
That his river will never run dry

questions.text: What would be put in Pharaoh's jaws?
questions.explanation: He says: I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will make the fish of your rivers stick to your scales.

questions.text: To whom was Pharaoh given for food once cast out into the wilderness?
questions.explanation: He says he will cast him out into the wilderness, where he will fall on the open field, and that he has given him for food to the animals of the earth and to the birds of the sky.

answers.text: To the fish that stick to his own scales
To the animals of the earth and the birds of the sky
To the peoples of the desolate countries
To the sword of the king of Babylon

questions.text: What had Egypt been to the house of Israel?
questions.explanation: The reason given is that they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel, which broke when they took hold of it.

questions.text: How far would the land of Egypt be made an utter waste?
questions.explanation: He says he is against Pharaoh and his rivers, and will make the land of Egypt an utter waste and desolation, from the tower of Seveneh even to the border of Ethiopia.

answers.text: From the tower of Seveneh to the border of Ethiopia
From the river of Egypt to the great sea
From the border of Moab to the hills of Edom
From the city of No to the gate of Babylon

questions.text: For how long would no foot of man or animal pass through Egypt?
questions.explanation: He says no foot of man will pass through it, nor any animal foot, and that it will not be inhabited for forty years.

questions.text: Into which land would the gathered Egyptians be brought back?
questions.explanation: He says he will reverse the captivity of Egypt and cause them to return into the land of Pathros, the land of their birth, where they will be a lowly kingdom.

answers.text: Into the land of the Philistines

questions.text: What does the chapter say Nebuchadnezzar's army received for its service against Tyre?
questions.explanation: It says his army served a great service against Tyre, every head was made bald and every shoulder worn, yet he had no wages, nor did his army.

answers.text: Silver and gold from the city

questions.text: Which land would be given to Nebuchadnezzar as the wages for his army?
questions.explanation: He says he will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will carry off her multitude and take her plunder as wages for his army.

questions.text: What does the last verse say would sprout for the house of Israel in that day?
questions.explanation: It says: in that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them.
